messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: PG_CONN_POOL_EXHAUSTED for cluster 'prod-eu-1' — threshold 85% exceeded (current 98%). Triggered 3167801234

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: Incident page fired -> pd_inc_8921. Escalation to on-call (Mia).

Mia (oncall): Acked. climbing in. grabbing context.

Sam (SRE): seeing increased 502/524 from API-read endpoints. Logs show "connection timeout" to postgres and Redis eviction spikes.

Priya (prod): Customer-facing metric: read_error_rate up to 12% over last 5m. Several sessions show >200ms db connect latency.

Alex (DB): Confirming pgbouncer max_client_count is saturated on two hosts. pgbouncer stats: `avg_client_wait_time` high, `active_clients` ~max. Also seeing heavy seq scan bursts from an analytic job.

Mia (oncall): Is this correlated with the @deploy that went out ~10m ago?

Sam (SRE): There was a small deploy 00:05UTC to the recommendations service. Canary passed but looks like it amplified a hot read pattern for certain keys.

Kara (support): Notified support queues — customers reporting slow search and some 5xx. Naming two customers: AcmeCorp and FreeRange.

Mia (oncall): Immediate mitigation plan: 1) briefly throttle non-critical traffic via FF, 2) increase pgbouncer pool on prod-eu-1, 3) identify/kill runaway analytic queries, 4) look at Redis eviction storm fallback. Assigning tasks.

Sam (SRE): I'll flip FF to reduce recommendations traffic by 60%. Doing now: `curl -XPOST https://ff.redwood/api/toggle -d '{"rec-service": "throttle-60"}'`

ops-bot: Feature flag change accepted, rollout id ff_7782, started 3167801272.

Alex (DB): Incrementing pgbouncer `max_client_conn` from 2048 -> 3072 on two hosts. Running:`kubectl exec -it pgbouncer-0 -- psql -c "ALTER SYSTEM SET max_client_conn = 3072"` then restart pgbouncer. Doing host1 now.

Sam (SRE): Rolling restart pgbouncer host1 -> host2 staggered. Watch for brief connection drops.

Mia (oncall): Priya, coordinate customer comms. Kara, post a short status in #support with ETA 15min.

Priya (prod): On it. Drafting: "We are experiencing increased database latency impacting reads; engineering is actively mitigating. Working on mitigation now — expect improvements within 15 minutes." Will tag AcmeCorp SRE.

Alex (DB): Host1 pgbouncer restart complete. Active clients dropped then recovered, wait times down ~70%. Host2 restart queued.

Sam (SRE): Observing Redis `evicted_keys` spike across primary replicas — TTL churn + heavy prefix scans from rec-service. That caused some cache misses and extra load to Postgres. We should throttle rec-service and add temp denylist for the offending prefix.

Mia (oncall): Alex -> can we promote standby or scale read replicas?

Alex (DB): Read replica count is at autoscale cap; can add one more but it'll take ~90s to attach. Starting a replica in eu region now.

ops-bot: Replica spin-up initiated: repl-attach-921, started 3167801410.

Sam (SRE): Rolling back the small recommendations deploy to prevent hot scans. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/recommendations --to-revision=15`

Priya (prod): Customer impact update: read_error_rate down from 12% -> 6% since pgbouncer host1 restart and FF throttle. Will update customers.

Kara (support): Posted update to #support and DMed affected customers. No escalation emails yet.

Alex (DB): Replica attached. Read traffic shifted. pgbouncer host2 restart done. Connection wait times normalized almost fully.

Mia (oncall): Good. Are there any long-running queries to kill?

Sam (SRE): Found a runaway analytic PID 32412 doing sequential scan on events table; killed it. Also applied a temporary index suggestion from query plan cached earlier.

incident-bot: Automated escalation suppressed due to active ack. PagerDuty: incident still open pd_inc_8921.

Priya (prod): Metrics now: api_read_5m_error 3.2%, p50 latency back near baseline, p95 improved but still 220ms. Redis evictions decreasing.

Alex (DB): Postgres connections at ~65% of new max. pgbouncer stats: `client_wait_seconds_total` dropping. No immediate signs of connection leak.

Mia (oncall): OK transition to handoff: I'll take it to stabilization for 30m then hand to Sam for post-incident work. Sam, you'll lead RCA and rollout safeguards (rate limit defaults + rec service patch).

Sam (SRE): Roger. I'll keep a watch for 30m and open an incident ticket with timeline and actions.

Priya (prod): I'll prepare customer follow-up with details and ETA for a final status update in 2h.

Kara (support): Marking ticket as "engineering mitigated" in Zendesk, will re-open if errors reappear.

Mia (oncall): pd_inc_8921 will remain open until postmortem. Handing off at 3167801800 — @Sam (SRE) taking lead.

Sam (SRE): Taking lead. Next steps: collect pgbouncer logs, redis eviction graphs, deploy diff, and the rec-service traces. Will create follow-up in #postmortems.

ops-bot: Incident timeline entry created: inc-2026-03-15-3167801234 by Mia.

Priya (prod): Confirmed no data loss, only increased latency/errors.

Mia (oncall): Closing immediate action loop. If anyone sees error rate climb >5% again, page PD. Thanks all :clap:

incident-bot: Note: Auto-escalation window lifted at 3167801899."
